## Package family name for Microsoft Store builds
- Build for Windows → Microsoft Store now has a **Package family name (PFN)** field. Paste the PFN from Partner Center → Product identity: it fills in the package name and checks that your name and publisher match it before building.
- Without one, the dialog shows the PFN your build will have, and every Store build reports its PFN.
- Claude's build_game command accepts and returns the package family name too.
